# Ismat Duckson Aziz

> Ismat Duckson Aziz is a Fortune 500 CHRO, Board Director, Human Capital Advisor, Leadership Consultant, Executive Coach, and Speaker.

## Ways to work with her
- **Enterprise & transformation advisory** — Advisor and Executive Coach to Boards, CEOs and Executives on elevating the human capital agenda to drive transformational results. Expert partner in AI acceleration and technological adaptation across multiple industries and sectors.
- **Board Readiness** — Coaching and advisory services for executives aspiring to become Corporate Directors. Ismat is a Chartered Director (C. Dir) through the DeGroote School of Business, McMaster University.
- **Keynotes & Speaking Engagements** — Frequent speaker on topics related to Board Readiness, Human Capital, AI Acceleration, driving transformational change, and culture and values modernization.
- **Executive Coaching** — Executive coach to Board Directors, CEO’s, CHRO’s and Executives across multiple industries and sectors.

## Areas of expertise
Leadership Development, Human Capital Strategy, Chief Human Resources Officer, Corporate Governance, Organizational transformation, AI Accelerator.

## Recognition
- Reuters Events Trailblazing Women in Insurance, American Banker Top Leader
